title: Tutor Eval Golden Record
description: One senior-teacher-authored query/ideal-response pair used to evaluate the trained tutor LLM. Stored versioned + hash-pinned in eval/golden_sets/.

query.description: Student-style question the tutor should be able to answer.

dimensions.description: The 4 dimensions a tutor response is scored on. Each score 0-5 represents the IDEAL response's hypothetical scoring — used for normalising eval-harness scores.

common_misconceptions_addressed.description: Optional. Specific misconceptions the ideal response is expected to address.

required_concepts.description: Optional. Concepts/formulas/terms the ideal response is expected to reference.

author_teacher_id.description: Senior teacher who authored this golden record. Trust anchor.

authored_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the record was authored.

notes_to_evaluator.description: Optional. Author notes for the LLM-judge to weigh (e.g. 'penalise heavily if the response omits the sign convention').
